'''Kennerlo Erlo''' lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and served as a [[Police officer/Legends|police officer]] with the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], he supplied his fellow officers with light [[Armor/Legends|armor]] from a small shop near the taxi station in [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] [[Black Sun territory|territory]].<ref name="TOR" />

Kennerlo was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] with dark brown hair, black [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], and fair skin. He wore a [[Coruscant Security Force uniform]] and carried a side arm [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kennerlo appears in the [[BioWare]] MMORPG ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a light armor vendor on Coruscant. The ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Explorer's Guide]]'' gave him a last name, though misspelled his first as "Kennerio."
